theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_extDeriv_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)), Differentiable ℝ β → ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), exteriorDerivative β (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = deriv (fun s : ℝ => β (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) t - ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) • fderiv ℝ (fun x' : Euclid N => β (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x'))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (Fin.removeNth j v i)))))) x (v j)
